name: MENDIKOT
description: Mendikot is a trick-taking card game from India, particularly popular in the western states of Maharashtra and Gujarat. It is a partnership game where the objective is to win tricks containing tens. The name comes from Gujarati where 'mendi' refers to the zero in '10' and 'kot' means a decisive victory where opponents score nothing.

content.text: Mendikot is a trick-taking card game from India, particularly popular in the western states of Maharashtra and Gujarat. It is a partnership game where the objective is to win tricks containing tens. The name comes from Gujarati where 'mendi' refers to the zero in '10' and 'kot' means a decisive victory where opponents score nothing.
Mendikot originated in western India, specifically in Maharashtra and Gujarat. The game reflects the Indian tradition of trick-taking games with specific card targets.
4 players in fixed partnerships, partners sitting opposite each other.
Standard 52-card deck. Ranking: A (high), K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 (low).
13 cards to each player, dealt in packets. The dealer is always a member of the losing team from the previous deal.

items.text: Mendikot with Trumps: Some variants include a trump suit determined by the first card played.
Point Scoring Variant: Some variants assign point values to other cards besides 10s.
